svg.text: Instruction cache — 4-way set associative, tree pseudo-LRU
4 sets × 4 ways × 1 word = 16 instructions. Lookup is purely combinational, so a hit costs zero cycles;
a miss raises cache_miss and freezes the whole pipeline until the IRAM handshake returns the word.
← 1-word lines: the block offset field is empty,
so the cache has no spatial locality at all (see § Known limitations).
tag compared against all 4 ways in parallel
plru[1] picks inside the left pair, plru[0] inside the right pair.
On every hit or fill the path is flipped away from the way just used,
so the victim is always the one on the ‘least recently used’ side.
Bug found and fixed during bring-up
The root bit used to be plru[0] while the update masks were written
for plru[2]. Ways 2 and 3 could never be chosen as victims, so the
cache silently behaved as a 2-way. Fixed by walking the tree from
plru[2] down — see the comment in a.b.c-Icache.vhd.
